demand_shift.description: The task multiset, release times, and total capacity workload are preserved, while threshold combinations are regrouped into unseen rolling-demand waves.

arrival_process.event_order: Each event is released after resolving the listed environment step and is visible in the next observation.
arrival_process.backlog: FIFO; all eight jobs count in W_all from reset and no job is dropped if its reserved cell is temporarily occupied.

fleet_shift.description: The fleet size, total capability, capability levels, map, observation interface, and workload are preserved, while the frequency of light, medium, and heavy robots is unseen during training.
